svg.aria-label: If AI replaces people while human problems remain unsolved, we have mistaken the purpose of progress. AI should extend human capability and bring expertise where it is needed most. Its purpose should not be to make people unnecessary, but to meet the needs we have not had the capacity to address. If we replace workers while leaving those needs unmet, we have mistaken efficiency for progress. Build AI to fill gaps in human capacity, not to create gaps in human livelihoods.
